crossRefs.note: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, Yahweh’s house and the king’s house
At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built Yahweh’s house and his own house,
I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.
I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
translations.bsb: Solomon, however, took thirteen years to complete the construction of his entire palace.
translations.kjv: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
translations.asv: And Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
